voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Uses sodium builder threads as part of voxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Maximum size in pixels (squared) of screenspace AABB before subdiving to smaller LoDs (Smaller being higher quality)
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Square XZ coverage distance of Voxy in chunks. Includes corner sections; these can increase rendering cost compared with circular coverage.
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or disables voxy rendering environmental fog
voxy.config.general.render_fog.tooltip: Enables or disables render fog effect
voxy.config.general.massive_clouds.toolt: Independent vanilla-textured clouds. Adjust height, width, thickness, speed and fade live below in this Voxy tab. Overrides vanilla/Sodium/Sodium Extra cloud settings, even Clouds: Off. Apply to save this toggle; disabling restores their cloud rendering. Shaderpacks keep their own clouds.
voxy.config.general.render_statistics.to: Enable render statistics in F3 menu, useful for debugging
voxy.config.clouds.height.tooltip: Bottom of the cloud layer in world blocks. Range -64 to 4096, step 16; default 320. Applies and saves immediately; Undo does not revert it. Requires Massive distant clouds enabled in Voxy; shaderpacks keep their own clouds.
voxy.config.clouds.cell_size.tooltip: Width of each cloud texture cell in blocks. Range 48 to 384, step 12; default 40 (4x vanilla). Smaller cells can cost more GPU time. Applies and saves immediately; Undo does not revert it. Requires Massive distant clouds enabled in Voxy; shaderpacks keep their own clouds.
voxy.config.clouds.thickness.tooltip: Cloud layer thickness in blocks. Range 4 to 256, step 4; default 40. Applies and saves immediately; Undo does not revert it. Requires Massive distant clouds enabled in Voxy; shaderpacks keep their own clouds.
voxy.config.clouds.speed.tooltip: Cloud drift relative to the original speed. Range 0% (stopped) to 1000% (10x), step 10%; default 500% (3 blocks/second at 20 TPS). Changes speed without jumping the clouds. Applies and saves immediately; Undo does not revert it. Requires Massive distant clouds enabled in Voxy; shaderpacks keep their own clouds.
voxy.config.clouds.fade_start.tooltip: Distance where clouds start fading, as a percentage of Voxy render distance (not vanilla distance). Range 0% to 98%; default 36%. Moves fade end up if needed. Applies and saves immediately; Undo does not revert it. Requires Massive distant clouds enabled in Voxy; shaderpacks keep their own clouds.
voxy.config.clouds.fade_end.tooltip: Distance where clouds disappear, as a percentage of Voxy render distance. Range 1% to 99%; default 99%. Moves fade start down if needed. Always fades before the render-distance edge. Applies and saves immediately; Undo does not revert it. Requires Massive distant clouds enabled in Voxy; shaderpacks keep their own clouds.
